source_discovery_limits: No usable Bodl.130 mentastrum/ebulus index entry was found in bounded official-domain search; no folio adjacency guess is installed as evidence.
Official Morgan text supplies two exact inscription leads; ebulus queries did not establish a usable primary catalogue candidate and do not become an image search.
A relative Morgan thumbnails link resolved to notfound; this did not prevent the two direct official folio pages.
text_policy: Case-only equality can be reported separately; spelling, abbreviations and grammatical endings must remain visible.
No shortening of qualifiers, silent lemmatization, modern species grouping, substring or root matching.
Catalogue transcription and actual visual character reading are separate evidence levels.
view_budget: Reuse three exact old Bodleian JPEGs; two official Morgan full-page JPEGs, then at most two actually linked detail images per Morgan leaf if needed for the fixed inscription. Exact native crops allowed; no enhancement, rotation, segmentation or morphology measurements.
freeze_is_not_blind_preregistration: Same AI already knows two source spreads, old control outputs and target names. No claim of expert independent verification or new blind set.
